experience.description:

• Built reusable modular frontend components in React and TypeScript, improving Core Web Vitals score from 68 to 94.
• Optimized PostgreSQL query indexes and Redis caching layers, eliminating database bottlenecks during high-traffic flash sales.

profile.summary: Full-Stack Developer (2023 B.E. graduate) with 1.5 years of production experience across enterprise SaaS, serverless IoT backends, and AI- powered web apps. Proficient in Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, Python, Node.js, and Flutter. Deployed end-to-end systems on AWS (Lambda, ECS, RDS, DynamoDB) with Terraform- managed infrastructure. Actively building AI-native products; ready to contribute from day one at early-stage startups.

experience.description:
• Designed & shipped an enterprise SaaS dashboard (Next.js + Tailwind CSS) in 3 months — role-based access,
• real-time data views, multi-tenant admin flows.
• Built an AI resume generation engine that auto-converts user
• data into formatted CV templates, cutting manual effort ~80%.
• Engineered an automated interview management
• system with Nest.js — backend-triggered emails, scheduling, and mock-interview session access.
• Deployed containerized Nest.js microservices on AWS ECS + ELB; AWS RDS for session and document persistence; Vercel + GitHub Actions for CI/CD.

• Built serverless IoT backend on AWS Lambda + API Gateway + DynamoDB + S3 for real-time water monitoring
• processing thousands of sensor events daily.
• Developed REST APIs in Python and Node.js; implemented authentication with AWS Cognito; automated deployments via Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions.

projects.title: AI-Powered Codebase Analyzer
projects.description:
• Ingests GitHub repos → auto-generates architecture breakdowns, tech-stack summaries, and Mermaid.js
• flowcharts. LLM-powered Q&A for semantic code queries.
• Real-time Security & Bug Scanner (risk-severity categorized). FastAPI ↔ Next.js WebSocket for streaming AI inference updates. Dark- mode premium UI with Markdown export.
